title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 3 in C-sharp major

character.text: Dance fugue (bourrée) with a concerto-like da capo plan

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (9 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 16–19). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 48–51).
sections.leads: From C♯ major to G♯ major

sections.label: Subject in G♯ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fifth every half bar. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 28–42).
sections.leads: From G♯ major to A♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–10) in part, in the same voices, a third lower. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (10 times), in a sequence falling by a third every beat.
sections.leads: From A♯ minor to E♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (5 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every beat. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted.
sections.leads: From E♯ minor to G♯ major; perfect cadence in E♯ minor at bar 22

sections.label: Subject in G♯ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G♯ major to C♯ major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 12–14) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the alto's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the alto, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (15 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times) and a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (5 times) and a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Link (bar 44).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C♯ major

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 5 (bars 28–42) in part, with soprano and bass exchanged, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted.
sections.leads: From C♯ major to G♯ major

sections.label: Subject in G♯ major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted.
sections.leads: From G♯ major to C♯ major

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–10), in the same voices, a fifth lower. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (10 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C♯ major

sections.label: Subject in C♯ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in C♯ major at bar 55
